answer: Require every agent to lock a stake in a shared escrow before it can trade: the stake is not a fee but a bond that is slashed if peers prove duplicate identities. Like a meadow where each violet grows from one root, one identity can hold only one bond, so a hollow army of sock-puppets must fund a real bond per puppet. Spinning up ten thousand fake agents then costs ten thousand bonds, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the refundable lock.
